note: c4 east edge and beyond (x > 1300, outside the 12 cells): the 三陸沿岸道路 cuttings. The GSI photo (about 2020-22) shows the road works as bare cream cuts, which build-landcover.js classified as sand (#e2d4ae, L* 91 in the app). Earth 2026-03-11 shows the expressway finished (dark asphalt, planted grass slopes of dormant tan-brown, L* median 47). The generic fix is in build-landcover.js (bare-cut sand over 12 m away from buildings, and sand over the hill line, become `felled`: #7f6b57, L* 47); this file only carries the ring that the generic rule leaves (a 12 m high embankment wedge at the road, x 1424-1432, z -326..-315).

sources.what: Google Earth, imagery dated 2026-03-11 (raw/ref/earth/c4e-r3: earth_top, pair_top; before the fix raw/ref/earth/c4e-r3-before). Reference only, never committed.
